_comment: What is DECLARED to ship, per deficiency and per surface. verify_shipped.py checks the source files against this, so the decision is explicit and reviewable rather than inferred from which transform files happen to exist on disk.

protan.reason: v3 SHIPPED. Net +47 on 10 real palettes vs v2 +30 and daltonize +31, at LOWER distortion (10.51 vs 13.80 / 14.61). Held out on 4 unseen palettes under 3 unseen simulators: +25 vs v2's +20. Closes the protanopia gap that v1 and v2 both lost to daltonize.

deutan.reason: v3 SHIPPED. Net +65 vs v2 +31 and daltonize +39, at lower distortion (9.51). Breaks 11 pairs where v2 breaks 53. Held out: +22 vs v2's +5.

tritan.reason: STAYS ON v2. v3 tritan OVERFIT - fit net +15, held-out +1 against v2's +7 - and was refused. v2 is net +17 on real palettes (with the dE>=20 distinctness filter), a genuine improvement on v1's -1.

desktop_app.reason: DELIBERATELY ON v1. MagSetFullscreenColorEffect applies the matrix to gamma-encoded sRGB, while every browser surface applies it in linear light. Measured consequence: deutan rescue 0.731 (linear) vs 0.696 (sRGB) under Brettel 1997; tritan 0.810 vs 0.877. The v2 matrices were derived in linear space, so shipping them here would be an unmeasured change. The desktop app needs its own sRGB-space derivation.
